title: WorkingTreeAdapter
responsibility: Lists and reads source from a Git worktree or an isolated verification snapshot.

inputs.name: WorkingTreeAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Directory whose source files are listed and read.

inputs.name: WorkingTreeAdapter.read.path
inputs.description: Path joined to the selected root for reading.

outputs.name: WorkingTreeAdapter.list
outputs.description: Source paths and Git-compatible blob hashes visible in the selected root.

outputs.name: WorkingTreeAdapter.read
outputs.description: UTF-8 contents of the requested source file.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An inaccessible root, missing file or invalid snapshot inventory stops the operation.
